_schema.scope: Frequently-used elements only (variant b per user choice). For other Z, refer to references/08b_xrf_lines_catalog.md and load on demand.
_schema.full_database: data/xray_lines_lsrm.sqlite — all 1766 lines, Z=5..104, 24 line types (Ka/Kb/La/Lb/Lg/Ll/Ln). Source: C:\LSRM\NuclideMaster\XRay_Viewer\X-ray.mdb (imported 2026-07-04). Query: SELECT element,Z,line,energy_keV,intensity FROM xray_lines WHERE energy_keV BETWEEN ? AND ?

fields.L: optional, only for Z > 60: [La1, Lb1, Lb2, Lg1] in keV
fields.context: where this element is typically seen in our pipeline

_schema.sources: NIST X-Ray Transition Energies Database (Deslattes 2003) + Bearden 1967 via reference 08b_xrf_lines_catalog.md. Full DB: LSRM NuclideMaster (2026-07-04).

Cu.context: Cu liner in graded shield, cryostat, electronics

Cd.context: Cd liner in graded shield (mid layer)

Sn.context: Sn liner in graded shield (most common mid layer)

I.context: NaI(Tl) crystal — gives escape peaks AND fluorescence

Ba.context: IC product of Cs-137 -> Cs-137m -> Ba-137; ALSO LaBr3 intrinsic

Te.context: IC product of I-125, Sb-125; CdZnTe crystal escape

W.context: W collimator/insert. CRITICAL: Ka1 overlaps Am-241 59.54 keV — disambiguate via Kb pair

Pb.context: Pb shielding — most common XRF signature in gamma spectroscopy

Bi.context: IC product of Bi-214 (Ra-226 chain); also Bi alloys

Th.context: Th-containing samples. CRITICAL: Ka2 89.96 overlaps U-235 89.96 gamma line

Np.context: IC product of Am-241 -> Np-237. L X-rays at 13.95, 17.75 are major

Pu.context: Pu samples (rare in typical lab measurements)
